hypothesis: The scratch 3D crop head and frozen-pretrained feature head make complementary daughter-pair ranking errors; one fixed equal percentile-rank average can improve high-precision parent recall without calibration sweeps.
single_candidate: Exact EXP161 evaluator and 0.50/0.50 stable percentile-rank average. EXP162 changes only the mistyped feature-head checksum; no metric, weight, threshold or data rule changed.
external_gate: On all parents from 64 external time-validation shards: proposal recall ceiling at least 0.90, ensemble precision at least 0.50 and recall at least 0.20; report component APs, ensemble AP and correlation.
competition_gate: Competition data remain closed unless external gate passes. Then freeze one rank threshold and require nonnegative reciprocal source results before one 24-movie prospective target pass.
resource: One RTX6000 through the common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 2 GiB disk, 20 minutes.
